summary: Escambia County fire tower named by Eastern US Lookouts and mapped in OpenStreetMap as an observation tower; no build, staffing or status source found.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts entry gives only the name and county. OpenStreetMap confirms a tower node with that name typed as an observation tower, with elevation 34 m in its tags; elevation is not quoted. Searches (two spellings, Philpot and Philpott) found no height, build date, builder, status or access source, so the story is short and does not meet the 120-word floor. Editor may prefer to hold this story until a source turns up. The brief's status and access are left unknown.
